digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate and LLM review criteria
propositions: T13 plan-review criterion currently triggers only on prohibition verbs (block, reject, deny, fail) and must be widened to include additive-obligation phrasings (contract, invariant, schema field, required argument, sites that must stay in sync) to close a demonstrated coverage gap

Deterministic pre-gate regex in det_gate_rules.py lacks alternation branch for additive-obligation lexicon, causing router-approved T13 plans to be deterministically skipped before evaluation; adding the branch and audit-verbatim enforcement restores reachability

Widened surface-parity content-trigger on CLI argument changes produces ~70% false positives (28/40 commits owe no MCP/NDJSON obligation) and its only demonstrated true-positive family is now covered by deterministic write-parity contract testing; LLM criterion adoption is rejected in favor of extending the contract's NDJSON/import adapter

Regenerated docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md must reflect T13 trigger wording changes and be validated by round-trip through the generator; hand-edits are prohibited and must be detected by guide-parity tests

Import-integrity criterion is declined and replaced with deterministic CI import-walk: full importlib walk of rebar.* in wheel-probe venv plus scripts/ import leg, avoiding false precision and LLM cost
ci-gate-compat criterion is rejected per prior operator ruling (6f2e-58a5) as institutionalizing gate-failure workarounds rather than fixing root causes; decline must be recorded in gap-analysis doc
